items.title: An overview of Jensen Huang’s messy days
items.zh_title: 黄仁勋动荡时期回顾
items.en_title: An overview of Jensen Huang’s messy days
items.summary: This is The Stepback, a weekly newsletter breaking down one essential story from the tech world. For more on Jensen Huang's resignation and the fallout from Nvidia's leadership crisis, follow Terrence O'Brien. The Stepback arrives in our subscribers' inboxes on Sunday at 8AM ET.…
items.zh_summary: 这是 The Stepback 每周通讯，本周聚焦科技圈的一件大事：黄仁勋辞职，以及英伟达领导层危机带来的后续影响。通讯会在周日早上 8 点（美东时间）发送到订阅者邮箱。
items.en_summary: This is The Stepback, a weekly newsletter breaking down one essential story from the tech world. For more on Jensen Huang's resignation and the fallout from Nvidia's leadership crisis, follow Terrence O'Brien. The Stepback arrives in our subscribers' inboxes on Sunday at 8AM ET.…
items.zh_take: CEO 的个人关系问题演变成公司危机，值得关注后续如何收场。

items.title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.zh_title: 英伟达安保团队去哪了
items.en_title: Where was Nvidia’s security team?
items.summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday…
items.zh_summary: 英伟达安全主管在 8 月悄然离职，随后 CEO 黄仁勋因个人关系问题辞职，其中一例涉及一名被怀疑向中国输送芯片的公司高管。一位前情报官员称，这类泄密其实每天都在发生。
items.en_summary: Nvidia’s security chief quietly left in August, and now that CEO Jensen Huang has stepped down over his relationships, including one with an executive at a company suspected of funneling chips to China, a former intelligence officer says it’s the kind of leak that runs everyday…
items.zh_take: 安全主管先走、CEO 后辞，芯片流向的漏洞可能比人事变动更关键。

items.title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.zh_title: 马斯克等高管联署请愿，要求 Nvidia 恢复黄仁勋 CEO 职务
items.en_title: Elon Musk, other tech execs sign petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang
items.zh_summary: 要求 Nvidia 恢复被罢免 CEO 黄仁勋职务的请愿书，截至周六下午已获得超过 11.5 万个签名，包括 5,965 名在职员工、1,108 名前员工和 63,063 名股东，马斯克、Replit CEO Amjad Masad 和 Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney 均已联署。
items.en_summary: A petition calling on Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang has gathered more than 115,000 signatures, including 5,965 current employees, 1,108 former employees and 63,063 shareholders. Elon Musk, Replit CEO Amjad Masad and Epic Games CEO Tim Sweeney have all signed.
items.zh_take: 员工、股东和同行一起发声，说明这场人事风波远不只是公司内部事务。

items.title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
items.zh_title: Anthropic CEO Amodei 在 IPO 前承认明年存在巨大不确定性，算力是公司最深的商业两难
items.en_title: Anthropic CEO Amodei admits "there's a huge uncertainty in what's going to happen next year" days before a record IPO
items.zh_summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 在 JPMorgan 投资者活动上表示，明年的走向存在巨大不确定性，算力是公司面临的最深商业两难：算力需提前一到两年购买，买少了影响客户和收入，买多了可能财务过度扩张。
items.en_summary: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei said at a JPMorgan investor event that there is huge uncertainty about what will happen next year. He described compute as the company's deepest business dilemma: it has to be bought one to two years ahead, and buying too little hurts customers and revenue while buying too much risks overextending finances.
items.zh_take: IPO 前夜承认看不清明年，算力押注成了 AI 公司共同的赌局。

items.title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.zh_title: AI 墓地：失败与跳票的项目盘点
items.en_title: The AI graveyard: a running list of projects and startups that didn’t make it
items.summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.
items.zh_summary: TechCrunch 整理了一份持续更新的清单，收录已经关停或未达预期的 AI 项目和创业公司。例子包括苹果多次延期的 Siri AI，以及 OpenAI 那次混乱的“超级应用”发布。
items.en_summary: From Apple's repeatedly delayed Siri AI to OpenAI's messy "super app" launch, here's a look at the AI projects that shut down or missed expectations.
items.zh_take: 失败案例集中摆出来，比只看成功故事更能看清 AI 落地的真实难度。

items.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
items.zh_title: 亚洲多国政府回应黄仁勋辞职
items.en_title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
items.summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
items.zh_summary: 黄仁勋辞去英伟达 CEO 后，一些亚洲政府着手确认芯片供应承诺是否仍然有效。另一些政府则在评估此事对本地项目的影响，或处理正在进行的调查。
items.en_summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.
items.zh_take: 一家公司的掌门人变动，牵动的是多国的芯片供应和项目进度。

items.title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
items.zh_title: OpenAI 前董事：AI 公司 CEO 仍不可信
items.en_title: The OpenAI board member who fired Sam Altman says we still can’t trust AI CEOs
items.summary: Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life. Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is…
items.zh_summary: 在 The Verge 的播客节目中，乔治城大学安全与新兴技术中心执行主任 Helen Toner 讨论了 AI 与现实生活的关系。她曾是 OpenAI 董事、参与解雇 Sam Altman，至今仍认为 AI 公司的 CEO 不值得信任。
items.en_summary: Today, I’m talking with Helen Toner, the executive director of the Center for Security and Emerging Technology at Georgetown University. This episode is part two of our series on AI in real life. Helen is a well-known figure in the AI safety and policy community, though she is…
items.zh_take: AI 治理的信任问题，从公司内部人事一直延伸到公众层面。

items.title: Open-source AI without Jensen
items.zh_title: Nathan Lambert 分析黄仁勋辞职后美国开源模型生态的真空
items.en_title: Open-source AI without Jensen
items.zh_summary: Nathan Lambert 撰文分析 Nvidia CEO 黄仁勋辞职对美国开源模型生态的冲击，认为 Nvidia 对开源模型的资金支持很可能随黄仁勋的离开而干涸，公司首要目标是稳住局面并向客户交付。
items.en_summary: Nathan Lambert analyzes how Jensen Huang's resignation as Nvidia CEO could hit the US open-source model ecosystem. He argues Nvidia's funding for open models will likely dry up as the company focuses on stabilizing the situation and delivering to customers.
items.zh_take: 开源模型的资金往往系于一两位关键人物，人一走，生态就可能断粮。

items.title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
items.zh_title: 黄仁勋离开 Nvidia：远见型创始人 CEO 时代落幕
items.en_title: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO
items.zh_summary: The Verge 长文回顾黄仁勋因走私丑闻和婚外情指控离开 Nvidia，分析这位执掌首家 5 万亿美元公司、占标普 500 约 6% 的创始人的离去意味着什么。
items.en_summary: The Verge looks back at Jensen Huang's departure from Nvidia amid a smuggling scandal and affair allegations. It asks what the exit of the founder who built the first $5 trillion company, roughly 6% of the S&P 500, means.
items.zh_take: 创始人兼任明星与 CEO 的模式，正在接受治理与私德的双重考验。

items.title: Fed releases financial stability report
items.zh_title: 美联储金融稳定报告：AI成为华尔街头号金融风险
items.en_title: Fed releases financial stability report
items.zh_summary: 美联储发布金融稳定报告，纽约联储调查显示87%的市场人士将AI列为首要金融风险，高于春季的50%。报告称对超级智能的市场热情推高股票估值；截至10月AI基础设施债务超6800亿美元，约为2023年全年的5倍、占投资级公司借贷约31%；最大银行对大型科技、数据中心建设及融资工具的风险敞口接近1万亿美元。
items.en_summary: The Fed's financial stability report says 87% of market participants now name AI as the top financial risk, up from 50% in spring. AI infrastructure debt topped $680 billion by October, about 31% of investment-grade corporate borrowing.
items.zh_take: AI 热潮已经从股市故事，变成银行账本上的真实风险敞口。

items.title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
items.zh_title: 亚马逊要建全球商品数据库，收录全网商品
items.en_title: Amazon has a plan to index the world’s online shopping data
items.summary: Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn't sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to Reuters. The project, called the "World Product Graph," is meant to make it less…
items.zh_summary: 据路透社报道，亚马逊计划建立一个覆盖全网商品的数据仓库，连自己不卖的商品也收录进去。这个名为「World Product Graph」的项目，会让这些信息通过亚马逊自己的网站对外提供。
items.en_summary: Amazon has plans to build a vault of data on every product sold anywhere on the internet, even products Amazon doesn't sell, and make the information available through its own site, according to Reuters. The project, called the "World Product Graph," is meant to make it less…
items.zh_take: 谁掌握商品数据，谁就掌握购物入口，这是在抢搜索的位置。

items.title: FT: Speaking with Jamie Dimon at a JPMorgan event in New York, Dario Amodei shrugged off market turmoil during Anthropic's roadshow.
items.zh_title: Dario Amodei 回应市场动荡：Anthropic IPO 前称对时机并不在意
items.en_title: FT: Speaking with Jamie Dimon at a JPMorgan event in New York, Dario Amodei shrugged off market turmoil during Anthropic's roadshow.
items.zh_summary: Dario Amodei 在纽约 JPMorgan 活动上与 Jamie Dimon 对谈，对 Anthropic IPO 路演期间的市场动荡不以为意，称对上市时机和市场状况不太在意。
items.en_summary: At a JPMorgan event in New York, Dario Amodei told Jamie Dimon he wasn't much concerned by market turmoil during Anthropic's IPO roadshow, saying he pays little attention to listing timing and market conditions.
items.zh_take: 热门 AI 公司上市前的表态，往往比路演材料更能说明底气。

items.title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.zh_title: Jensen Huang 离任或给 AI 创业融资留下大缺口，投资人和创始人担忧
items.en_title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
items.zh_summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 正式辞职，创投圈认为其继任者 Colette Kress 更保守，短期难延续他每年数十亿美元、今年已参与 105 轮的投资节奏。
items.en_summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has formally resigned, and VCs say his successor Colette Kress is more conservative. They expect it will be hard in the short term to match his pace of billions of dollars in annual investments and the 105 rounds he has already joined this year.
items.zh_take: 黄仁勋是 AI 投资的重要出资人，他离开可能让初创公司融资更难。

items.title: Jerusalem Daily: Mass funeral in Gaza as Netanyahu clings to power
items.zh_title: 加沙举行集体葬礼，内塔尼亚胡苦撑执政
items.en_title: Jerusalem Daily: Mass funeral in Gaza as Netanyahu clings to power
items.summary: A mass funeral was held in Gaza for 70 Palestinians whose bodies were trapped under the rubble.
items.zh_summary: 加沙为70名此前被困在废墟下的巴勒斯坦人举行集体葬礼。与此同时，以色列总理内塔尼亚胡仍在艰难维持自己的执政地位。
items.en_summary: A mass funeral was held in Gaza for 70 Palestinians whose bodies were trapped under the rubble.
items.zh_take: 葬礼与权力困局同时上演，战争的人道代价和停火问责仍看不到出口。

items.title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
items.zh_title: 电信升级工作引发美国航班混乱
items.en_title: How telecoms upgrade work sparked US flight chaos
items.summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.
items.zh_summary: 美国官员表示，这次航班混乱是老旧设备过载造成的，不是网络攻击。相关混乱与电信升级工作有关。
items.en_summary: US officials say the disruption was caused by old equipment overloading and not a cyber-attack.
items.zh_take: 基础设施升级也会带来连锁风险，排障时先厘清设备与攻击的边界。

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.zh_title: 英伟达陷芯片流向争议，关联公司称涉事者已离任
items.en_title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
items.zh_summary: Megaspeed表示，一名被怀疑与中国间谍活动有关、并与英伟达前掌门人有联系的人员已于2025年离开公司。这起丑闻引发质疑：在美国限制之下，先进AI芯片是否仍流入了中国。
items.en_summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
items.zh_take: 出口管制的实际漏洞，往往比政策文件上写的更难堵住。

items.title: Flames engulf Syrian refugee camp in eastern Lebanon
items.zh_title: 黎巴嫩东部叙利亚难民营燃起大火
items.en_title: Flames engulf Syrian refugee camp in eastern Lebanon
items.summary: A fire tore through a Syrian refugee camp in Bar Elias, eastern Lebanon.
items.zh_summary: 黎巴嫩东部巴勒伊亚斯的一处叙利亚难民营发生火灾，火焰吞噬了营地。报道未提及起火原因和伤亡情况。
items.en_summary: A fire tore through a Syrian refugee camp in Bar Elias, eastern Lebanon.
items.zh_take: 难民营的日常风险少有人关注，一场火就能让难民失去仅有的一切。

items.title: Fascism built the AI bubble. What will burst it?
items.zh_title: 娜奥米·克莱恩谈AI泡沫与灾难资本主义
items.en_title: Fascism built the AI bubble. What will burst it?
items.summary: In the latest episode of Deja Vu, Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor examine the latest model of disaster capitalism.
items.zh_summary: 在《Deja Vu》最新一期节目中，娜奥米·克莱恩和阿斯特拉·泰勒讨论了灾难资本主义的最新形态。她们把当下AI泡沫的成因与法西斯主义联系起来分析。
items.en_summary: In the latest episode of Deja Vu, Naomi Klein and Astra Taylor examine the latest model of disaster capitalism.
items.zh_take: 把AI热潮放进政治经济史里看，泡沫就不只是技术问题。

items.title: New Orleans port files $1m lawsuit over 'miracle on the Mississippi' tanker collision
items.zh_title: 新奥尔良港就油轮撞邮轮提诉索赔
items.en_title: New Orleans port files $1m lawsuit over 'miracle on the Mississippi' tanker collision
items.summary: The lawsuit filed by New Orleans officials also requests that the tanker involved in the collision with the cruise ship be seized and sold to pay for damages.
items.zh_summary: 新奥尔良官员就油轮与邮轮相撞一事提起诉讼，索赔100万美元。诉讼还要求扣押涉事油轮并予以出售，用来赔偿损失。
items.en_summary: The lawsuit filed by New Orleans officials also requests that the tanker involved in the collision with the cruise ship be seized and sold to pay for damages.
items.zh_take: 港口用诉讼加扣船来追偿，说明这起碰撞的账还远没算完。

items.title: Twenty Years of Al Jazeera English: The Counternarrative
items.zh_title: 半岛电视台英语频道开播二十年
items.en_title: Twenty Years of Al Jazeera English: The Counternarrative
items.summary: Two decades of AJE: Shaping media, amplifying unheard voices and driving global conversations.
items.zh_summary: 半岛电视台英语频道迎来开播二十年。它称这二十年里参与塑造媒体报道，放大少被听见的声音，并推动全球讨论。
items.en_summary: Two decades of AJE: Shaping media, amplifying unheard voices and driving global conversations.
items.zh_take: 它让人看到全球新闻叙事并非只有单一视角，值得观察。

items.title: ‘Almost magic’ as SpaceX craft caught mid-air: Why it matters
items.zh_title: 星舰完成太空飞行后成功返回发射台
items.en_title: ‘Almost magic’ as SpaceX craft caught mid-air: Why it matters
items.summary: SpaceX's Starship successfully returned to its launchpad after orbiting in space.
items.zh_summary: SpaceX的星舰在太空轨道飞行后成功返回发射台。报道把这次回收形容为“近乎魔法”。
items.en_summary: SpaceX's Starship successfully returned to its launchpad after orbiting in space.
items.zh_take: 火箭能飞回原地，可重复使用才真正立得住，发射成本才有下降空间。

items.title: Can Netanyahu and Eisenkot form a ‘unity’ government in Israel?
items.zh_title: 利库德与耶沙尔周日磋商联合政府
items.en_title: Can Netanyahu and Eisenkot form a ‘unity’ government in Israel?
items.summary: Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday, but will need to overcome major differences to work together.
items.zh_summary: 利库德集团与耶沙尔党定于周日举行会谈，讨论在以色列组建联合政府。双方分歧不小，要合作仍需跨过不少障碍。
items.en_summary: Yashar and Likud are scheduled to hold talks on Sunday, but will need to overcome major differences to work together.
items.zh_take: 以色列政局能不能稳下来，很大程度上要看这两家谈不谈得拢。

items.title: Germany vs Netherlands: Nations League – preview, team news, predictions
items.zh_title: 德国对荷兰：欧国联出线关键战前瞻
items.en_title: Germany vs Netherlands: Nations League – preview, team news, predictions
items.summary: Germany will likely need to win on Monday to reach the quarterfinals unless Serbia beat Greece away from home.
items.zh_summary: 德国周一很可能必须赢下荷兰，才能进入欧国联四分之一决赛。除非塞尔维亚在客场击败希腊，德国才有别的出路。
items.en_summary: Germany will likely need to win on Monday to reach the quarterfinals unless Serbia beat Greece away from home.
items.zh_take: 一场球就决定出线，德国这场没有太多退路。

items.title: Gaza families bury bodies of loved ones trapped for years under rubble
items.zh_title: 加沙北部找回69具遗骸 家属安葬亲人
items.en_title: Gaza families bury bodies of loved ones trapped for years under rubble
items.summary: The remains of 69 Palestinians have been recovered in northern Gaza, allowing families to bury them.
items.zh_summary: 加沙北部找回69名巴勒斯坦人的遗骸，家属终于能够安葬亲人。这些遗体此前多年被埋在废墟之下。
items.en_summary: The remains of 69 Palestinians have been recovered in northern Gaza, allowing families to bury them.
items.zh_take: 除了停火，把亲人从废墟里找回来好好安葬，也是家属最急的事。

items.title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.zh_title: 伊朗无人机袭击巴林美军基地
items.en_title: Iran targets US military base in Bahrain with drone attack
items.summary: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.
items.zh_summary: 伊朗用无人机袭击了位于巴林的美军基地，这是三天内对该国的第二次袭击。美伊围绕霍尔木兹海峡的对峙仍在持续。
items.en_summary: It marks the second attack on the country in three days and comes as the US and Iran remain locked in a stand-off over the Strait of Hormuz.
items.zh_take: 袭击接连发生，霍尔木兹的紧张正一步步往军事冲突上滑。

items.title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
items.zh_title: 韩国税务会计考试最高分者承认作弊
items.en_title: South Korea's top scorer in tax accountancy exam admits cheating
items.summary: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.
items.zh_summary: 34岁的韩元锡承认，在税务会计考试中用隐藏摄像头和AI作弊，拿到接近满分的成绩。他是这场考试的最高分获得者。
items.en_summary: Han Won-seok, 34, confessed to using a hidden camera and AI to get a near-perfect mark on the significant test.
items.zh_take: 靠AI作弊还拿了第一，考试的公平和监管都该重新想想了。

items.title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.zh_title: Megaspeed称涉英伟达前老板疑似间谍已离职
items.en_title: Suspected China spy linked to Nvidia's ex-boss left in 2025, Megaspeed says
items.summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
items.zh_summary: Megaspeed表示，一名与英伟达前老板有关联、被怀疑是中国间谍的人已于2025年离职。这起英伟达风波引发质疑：在美国限制之下，先进AI芯片是否仍流入了中国。
items.en_summary: The Nvidia scandal has raised questions over whether advanced AI chips ended up in China, despite US restrictions.
items.zh_take: 芯片出口管制背景下，间谍疑云让AI硬件流向问题更受关注。

items.title: Social Security and the blue wave: What could happen to payroll taxes and senior tax breaks
items.zh_title: 中期选举后社保与工资税走向

items.zh_take: 一张合辑既是悼念，也让留下来的人有了继续向前的理由。

items.title: Hannah Fry feels 'unbelievably lucky' after cervical cancer treatment
items.zh_title: 汉娜·弗莱宫颈癌治疗后称“五年无癌”
items.en_title: Hannah Fry feels 'unbelievably lucky' after cervical cancer treatment
items.summary: The presenter says she has received a 'five-year clear' after having a hysterectomy in her thirties.
items.zh_summary: 主持人汉娜·弗莱在三十多岁时接受子宫切除术后，表示自己已经“五年无癌”。她说能取得这样的结果感到“难以置信地幸运”。
items.en_summary: The presenter says she has received a 'five-year clear' after having a hysterectomy in her thirties.
items.zh_take: 公众人物公开癌症复查结果，能让更多人关注宫颈癌筛查和治疗。

items.title: Holly Humberstone: People can't connect to a pop star who's 'too polished'
items.zh_title: 霍莉·亨伯斯通：流行歌手不必过度精致
items.en_title: Holly Humberstone: People can't connect to a pop star who's 'too polished'
items.summary: The singer felt forced to compete with her female peers, until she realised the power of longevity.
items.zh_summary: 她说，流行歌手如果“太精致”，人们反而难以产生连接。她一度被迫与同龄女歌手竞争，后来才意识到长久发展的力量。
items.en_summary: The singer felt forced to compete with her female peers, until she realised the power of longevity.
items.zh_take: 在追求完美的流行乐坛，真实感和长久发展可能比一时精致更重要。
